to.name: RFC 6675 conservative SACK-based TCP loss recovery

property: RFC 6675 consumes SACK block feedback to maintain a loss scoreboard, estimate data in flight, and select retransmissions during multiple-loss recovery.

date_or_range.notes: RFC 6675 obsoletes RFC 3517 while relying on RFC 2018 SACK semantics.

negative_claims: SACK feedback is not itself a congestion-window growth algorithm.
This edge does not imply that SACK replaced NewReno everywhere.
open_questions: Map Linux SACK scoreboard generations to RFC 3517, RFC 6675, and later RACK recovery.
